notes: 6.9: subtitle, audio and video content now uses the purpose-built "subtitle" translation mode automatically (short spoken-style lines plus a display-length check) whenever you are still on the default mode; an explicit Precise/Natural/Polish choice is always respected, and documents are unaffected. The DeepSeek entry is renamed DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and now sends the canonical model id — the old "deepseek-v4-flash" was only a legacy alias for the same model, so this is not a capability change and no key re-entry is needed. Also carries everything from 6.8.1-6.8.3: no duplicated real-time captions, visible GPU queue for video tasks, no lone "…" cues, no >256 MB source copies (temp kept under 20 GB), per-scene translation of repeated subtitle lines, custom languages in the glossary, deleting a history record deletes its proofread data, and thinking mode off by default on every backend. / 6.9：字幕、音频和视频现在自动使用「字幕」翻译模式（要求译文简洁口语化，并检查每行长度是否适合显示）——前提是你还停在默认模式；若你明确选过「精确」「自然」「润色」，一律按你选的来，文档不受影响。DeepSeek 条目更名为 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 并改用官方的规范模型名——原来的 "deepseek-v4-flash" 只是指向同一模型的旧别名，所以这不是能力变化，也不需要重新填写密钥。本版同时包含 6.8.1 至 6.8.3 的全部修复：实时字幕不再重复、视频任务会说明正在排队等待 GPU、不再写入孤零零的「…」字幕、不再复制超过 256 MB 的源文件（临时目录控制在 20 GB 以内）、字幕中重复的台词按场景分别翻译、自定义语言可用于术语表、删除历史记录时一并删除校对记录、所有后端默认关闭思考模式。
